children: Airbus SE (EURONEXT:AIR) accelerated deliveries and orders through August, hit new deals from airlines and lessors, advanced A350F maiden flight prep, launched a € buyback to support equity plans, and won major defence and space contracts—including OneWeb satellites and French SIGINT and drone awards—while nearing A350 sales to Vietnam.
Previous Week Recap
Airbus Se Deliveries And Orders
: Airbus (AIR) delivered 57 planes in August, 475 YTD through Aug 2026 vs 434 a year ago. It reported 67 gross orders in August, 1,157 gross and 1,091 net orders YTD; 2026 delivery target 870.
Airbus Se Opens Buyback Window

: Airbus SE (AIR) launches open-market buyback from 11 Sep to 6 Nov 2026 to repurchase up to 4.1M shares under EU rules, supporting employee share plans and equity compensation; authorized by 2026 AGM.
Airbus Targets A350F Maiden Flight
: Airbus (AIR) targets Sept. 29 for the A350F maiden flight from Toulouse; date may shift due to weather as Airbus readies the freighter to enter the cargo market against Boeing.
Airbus Defense Secures OneWeb Contract
: Airbus (AIR) said its Defence & Space unit got approval to start a contract with Eutelsat for 229 OneWeb satellites, adding to 440 OneWeb sats already ordered; no financial terms disclosed.
Airbus To Deliver Air Cairo Jets
: Airbus to deliver about 15 A320/A320neo jets to Air Cairo under a firm order, with options for up to 15 more; deal secures slots as carrier targets fleet growth to 130+ by 2034.
BOC Aviation Orders A320neo
: BOC Aviation ordered 12 Airbus A320neo jets for delivery in 2029 and signed a long-term lease with Avianca; deliveries come from Airbus SE (AIR).
Airbus Wins CASSIOPÉE Lead Contract
: Airbus SE (AIR) won lead contract for France’s CASSIOPÉE SIGINT satellite program; Unseenlabs is co-contractor. Program aims to replace CERES and sustain France’s space SIGINT capability by 2032.
Airbus Secures U050 Drone Order
: Airbus (AIR) won a French military order for four U050 Capa‑X drone systems (each system = two U050 UAVs); two systems go to the French Navy, two to the French Army.
Airbus MoU For Vietnam A350-900
: Airbus (AIR) nears a provisional sale of five A350-900s to Vietnam Airlines under a signed MoU; deliveries set for 2033–2034 and announcement expected during Vietnam president's Paris visit.
